title: gait-summary/1
description: One run of `fy gait <spec>`: joint loads for level treadmill walking on Freyja's mass distribution, computed three ways (B own dynamics, A measured force scaled, H own total force at the measured CoP) from the Camargo et al. 2021 kinematics. Stamped like a run record. Statistics are across subject-strides as {mean, p95, max}, with an `all` and a `without_offset` variant (the spec's offset_subjects removed). Torques are N m about the model's hinge axes, speeds rad/s, powers W, forces % of Freyja's body weight, angles degrees. Written by sim/scripts/gait.py; CONVENTIONS section 6.

spec_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the spec

results.description: Per speed (key '1.4'): n_strides, joints{joint{method{metric{all,without_offset{mean,p95,max}}}}}, bound (worst case over the feasible double-support splits), residual, agreement, feasibility (CoP outside / friction exceeded, by phase bin), hip_extension, kinematics.

sensitivity.description: 95th-percentile peak torque of method B per joint and speed at each smoothing cutoff and pelvis-tilt offset, on stride_cap_per_subject strides per subject.
